text:
maria: Heads up 3 CI started failing after the edge-adapter roll2. Tests pass locally (node 20) but CI (node 18 image) errors with "Cannot use import statement outside a module" in a few Jest/Vitest suites. Anyone run into this?
kevin: yup. Are we shipping "type": "module" in package.json now?
maria: yeah, we moved to ESM everywhere. stack trace is CJS loader complaining.
ashley: matrix runs both jest and vitest. Vitest + edge plugin emits ESM-only bundles.
sam: vitest handles ESM but mocking CJS deps gets hairy. For Jest you can either run in ESM mode or transform the ESM packages.
maria: repro: `pnpm -w test:ci`. Locally Node 20 = green. CI Node 18 = red.
kevin: quick fixes: - For Jest: add `transform` for the ESM-scoped packages and `extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts']` if running node in ESM. - For Vitest: set `test: { deps: { inline: ['@redwood/*', 'edge-adapter'] } }` in vite.config.ts.
nashley: tried `--experimental-vm-modules` in CI for jest; it moved things but broke some `jest.mock()` semantics on default exports.
sam: also check tsconfig (`module: ESNext`, `moduleResolution: node16`) and package.json `exports` field 3 these change how resolution happens under runners.
maria: temporary plan: pin CI image to node 20, add deps.inline for vitest for the edge packages, and add a small transform rule for jest for the scoped ESM libs. I'll open a PR with notes.
infra-bot: Created issue RDW-1287 for CI ESM flake. CI run: https://ci.internal/rdw/runs/4599
kevin: one more tip 3 for legacy mocks, switch to `import * as mod from 'mod'` or update mocks to `vi.mock()`/ESM-style so they behave under both runners.
maria: thanks all, will post CI results after PR lands :thumbsup:
